compatibilityReadback.metadataPolicy: Kotlin 2.2 reads non-strict 2.3 metadata within the compiler's next-version compatibility window; this was confirmed from the Kotlin 2.2.10 compiler's MetadataVersion.INSTANCE_NEXT policy. No -Xskip-metadata-version-check and no global Kotlin bump.
compatibilityReadback.apiReadback: rememberHazeState(blurEnabled), hazeSource(state,zIndex,key), hazeEffect(state,style,block), HazeEffectScope background/tints/fallbackTint/blurRadius/noiseFactor, and HazeDefaults.style exist in the fixed tag. HazeDialog is deprecated because plain Dialog works; cross-window pre-draw invalidation is automatic.
compatibilityReadback.toolchainNote: Do not bypass artifact metadata. Main owns the version catalog, lockfiles and verification metadata update; the measured resolution adds activity 1.12.2 and tracing-ktx 1.3.0, which must be reflected in the lock/verification set rather than excluded.

integration.policy: Real source→effect connection only. SDK 28-31, a disabled preference, or a scene with no source paints the opaque semantic surface; no translucent alpha is presented as blur.
integration.runtimeAssets: The AAR contains haze_noise.webp; no Apple font or SF Symbol asset is redistributed.
